name: Model Router
description: Routes prompts to a local or cloud model.

classifier.description: Ask local Gemma to label each message (router v2). Default true.

classifierTimeoutMs.description: Classifier time limit; on timeout the scoring fallback decides. Default 2000.

ollamaUrl.description: Loopback Ollama base URL for health checks and the classifier: http://127.0.0.1:11434 (laptop) or http://127.0.0.1:11435 (container forwarder).

simulateRateLimit.description: Demo switch (A9): pretend the cloud is rate-limited. Default false.

heldReply.description: Reply for a private request while the local model is down (A8).

longContextHeldReply.description: Reply for a private request in a chat too long for the local model (held, asks for /new).

unavailableReply.description: Reply when the cloud is (simulated) rate-limited and local is down.

logMirrorFile.description: Optional copy of router log lines (metadata only) for laptop testing.

traceHooks.description: Laptop debugging: write hook arrival metadata to logMirrorFile only. Default false.

privateWhenLocalDown.description: Private message while local Gemma is down: 'cloud' (ChatGPT answers, default) or 'held' (no model; heldReply).

followupWindowMs.description: Follow-up rule: a reply to a question the cloud model asked in a tool/reasoning task within this many ms stays on the cloud (Gemma verifies it). 0 = off. Default 300000.
